mapper.update: UPDATE qms_ipqc a INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN defect_level = 'CR' THEN defect_quantity ELSE 0 END ) AS cr_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN defect_level = 'MAJ' THEN defect_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS maj_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN defect_level = 'MIN' THEN defect_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS min_quantity, qid.`qc_id` as 'ipqc_id' FROM qms_defect_record qid WHERE qid.qc_id = #{ipqcId} and qid.qc_type = 'IPQC' GROUP BY qid.qc_id ) b ON a.`id` = b.ipqc_id SET a.cr_quantity=b.cr_quantity,a.maj_quantity=b.maj_quantity,a.min_quantity=b.min_quantity, a.`cr_rate`= ROUND(b.cr_quantity/a.`quantity_check`*100,2), a.`maj_rate`= ROUND(b.maj_quantity/a.`quantity_check`*100,2), a.`min_rate`= ROUND(b.min_quantity/a.`quantity_check`*100,2) WHERE a.id = #{ipqcId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.process_id, p.process_code, p.process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS inspection_count, -- 检验次数 SUM(i.quantity_check) AS total_inspected, -- 总检测数量 SUM(i.quantity_qualified) AS total_qualified, -- 合格数量 SUM(i.quantity_unqualified) AS total_unqualified, -- 不合格数量 ROUND(SUM(i.quantity_qualified) / SUM(i.quantity_check) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate, -- 合格率 ROUND(SUM(i.cr_quantity) / SUM(i.quantity_check) * 100, 2) AS critical_defect_rate, -- 致命缺陷率 ROUND(SUM(i.maj_quantity) / SUM(i.quantity_check) * 100, 2) AS major_defect_rate, -- 严重缺陷率 ROUND(SUM(i.min_quantity) / SUM(i.quantity_check) * 100, 2) AS minor_defect_rate -- 轻微缺陷率 FROM qms_ipqc i JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT process_id, process_code, process_name FROM qms_ipqc WHERE process_id IS NOT NULL ) p ON i.process_id = p.process_id WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.process_id, p.process_code, p.process_name ORDER BY pass_rate DESC
